These are the questions experienced brand owners put to us before they sign. Here are the answers in writing.

Straight answer

Can I cancel?

Yes. There are no lock-ins. Give 30 days’ notice. Any unused balance is refunded within 14 days of your final statement, less work done and costs already committed.

Straight answer

Do my reps carry other brands?

Yes. One rep visit can present several brands. Field bookings are charged per brand, per customer, so you pay only for time booked to yours.

Straight answer

Can I hire a rep I meet through you?

Yes. A placement fee of 30% of their first-year pay applies if you hire them within 12 months.

Straight answer

How do I pay?

From a prepaid wallet, by direct debit (preferred) or card. You are alerted when the balance falls below 20% of one billing period, and unused funds roll over while you subscribe.

Straight answer

Will you guarantee sales?

No one honestly can. What you get is every visit logged, every hour approved before it’s charged, and a 30-day pro-rata money-back guarantee on your first month.
